description_en: Invokes the UploadMediaByURL operation to pull audio and video media files from source file URLs for upload. Batch uploads are supported. This operation is mainly applicable to scenarios where files are not stored on a local service or terminal and need to be uploaded through a URL that supports public network access
description_zh: 调用UploadMediaByURL基于源文件URL，拉取音视频媒体文件进行上传，支持批量上传。本接口主要适用于文件没有存储在本地服务器或终端，需要通过公网访问的URL地址上传的场景
kebab_example: aliyun ice upload-media-by-url --upload-urls https://diffurl.mp4 --app-id app-1000000 --user-data MessageCallback_:_CallbackURL_:_http://example.aliyundoc.com_,_Extend_:_localId_:_xxx_,_test_:_www --upload-target-config StorageType_:_oss_,_StorageLocation_:_outin-000.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com --media-meta-data SourceURL_:_https://example.aliyundoc.com/video01.mp4_,_Title_:_urlUploadTest --post-process-config ProcessType_:_Workflow_,_ProcessID_:_b72a06c6beeb4dcdb898feef067b1000 --entity-id d67281da3c8743b8823ad12976187000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UploadMediaByURL

parameters.help_en:
The URL of the media source file.
The URL must include a file name extension. For example, mp4 is the file name extension in `https://****.mp4`.
    - If the URL does not include a file name extension, you can specify the FileExtension parameter in `UploadMetadatas`.
    - If the URL includes a file name extension and the FileExtension parameter is also specified, the value of FileExtension takes precedence.
URL-encode the URLs. Separate multiple URLs with commas (,). A maximum of 20 URLs are supported.
To prevent upload failures caused by special characters, URL-encode each URL before concatenating them with commas
parameters.help_zh:
媒体源文件URL。
URL中需要包括扩展名, 比如`https://****.mp4`中mp4为扩展名。
    - 如果URL中不包含扩展名，可以在`UploadMetadatas`中传入`FileExtension`来指定。
    - 如果URL中有扩展名且同时传入`FileExtension`，以传入的`FileExtension`为准。
URL编码，多个地址之间以半角逗号（,）分隔，最多支持20个。
避免存在特殊字符导致无法上传视频，需要URL编码后再做逗号拼接
parameters.name: upload_urls

parameters.help_en: The custom settings. The value is a JSON string that supports settings such as message callbacks
parameters.help_zh: 自定义设置。为JSON字符串，支持消息回调等设置
parameters.name: user_data

parameters.help_en:
The destination storage address.

StorageType: only oss is supported.
StorageLocation: only VOD storage is supported. User-owned OSS storage is not supported
parameters.help_zh:
目标存储地址。

StorageType 取值：仅支持oss。
StorageLocation 仅支持VOD点播存储，不支持用户自有OSS存储
parameters.name: upload_target_config

parameters.help_en:
The metadata of the media file to be uploaded. The value is a JSON string.
The metadata takes effect only when it matches a URL in UploadURLs.
JSON format: [UploadMetadata, UploadMetadata, ...]. The value must be converted to a JSON string.
For more information, see the UploadMetadata table below
parameters.help_zh:
上传媒体文件的元数据信息，为JSON字符串。
与UploadURLs里的URL匹配才能生效。
JSON格式：[UploadMetadata, UploadMetadata,…]，需转为JSON字符串 。
更多信息，请参见下表UploadMetadata
parameters.name: media_meta_data

parameters.help_en:
The post-upload processing action when Type is set to video or audio.

Valid values of ProcessType: Workflow
parameters.help_zh:
Type = video  || audio  有上传后处理动作。

ProcessType取值：Workflow
parameters.name: post_process_config

parameters.help_en: The entity ID. You can call the CreateEntity operation to create an entity and define a custom dynamic metadata structure
parameters.help_zh: 实体 ID。可调用CreateEntity接口创建实体，自定义动态元数据结构
parameters.name: entity_id

items.description_en: The details of the upload task

SourceURL.description_en: The source file URL of the upload task
SourceURL.description_zh: 上传任务对应的源文件URL
